name: Reserved Table
source:
Your friend has gone missing.
To find her, you get a job at the company where she used to work.

The work there is special.
You have to take care of two monsters and interview them.
And they seem to really like you.

[From [url=https://nionola.itch.io/reservedtable]itch.io[/url]]
